newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy car market seen falling further in Q4 - Unrae.
newsitem.headline: Italy car market seen falling further in Q4 - Unrae.

text.p: The sharp fall in Italian September new car registrations confirmed a worrying drop in orders and pointed to a further slide in the last quarter of this year, Italian car importers' association Unrae said.
Italian new car registrations fell 8.55 percent year-on-year last month, Transport Ministry figures showed on Thursday.
Unrae said in a statement it forecast total 1996 sales well below last year's 1.7 million vehicles.
In such a negative context and when sales in the rest of Europe were rising, even incentives to boost demand in Italy "would not be enough to change the gloomy picture," it said.
To reverse the trend the government should take structural measures to boost the Italian economy and so create more confidence among consumers, Unrae said.
